ip: IP address of the LG WebOS TV
mac: MAC address of the LG WebOS TV
invalid_mac: Invalid MAC address. Expected format: AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF
power: Turn off the TV as a remote control button
wolwithip: Include IP Address in Wake-On-LAN packet to use unicast (travels across subnets)
help_tip: At first connection from ioBroker to your TV you must allow this connection on your TV screen.
